question: Recently, the internationally renowned folk dance artist Ram Sahay Panday, a Padma Shri recipient, passed away. He represented which folk dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Padma Shri awardee Ram Sahay Panday, an eminent Rai folk dancer from Madhya Pradesh, passed away at the age of 92.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ram Sahay Panday was a prominent exponent of the Rai folk dance form of the Bundelkhand region.**
 
• He had performed over 100 times across 18 countries, promoting Indian folk culture globally.
 
• **He received the Padma Shri in 2022** for his contribution to traditional arts.
 
• **He mixed Rai dance with Mridangam tunes to create unique and captivating performances.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• He was a resident of Sagar district in Madhya Pradesh and passed away after a prolonged illness.
 
• Madhya Pradesh CM Mohan Yadav lauded his journey of pursuing art despite hardships.
 
• The Rai folk dance, traditionally performed by the Bedia community, gained national and international recognition due to his efforts.
 
• He is survived by his wife and a son.
